characters.name: The Mogul
characters.text: When auction bids are compared, your bid counts as $10 higher than it is. You still pay your real bid. You win ties and any auction where you're within $10 of the top bid.

characters.name: The Hustler
characters.text: Once per Casino visit, you may reroll your dice (High/Low) or your duel roll (Dice Duel).

characters.name: The Commuter
characters.text: Start the game with 3 Momentum tokens instead of 1. Your token limit is 6 instead of 5.

characters.name: The Lawyer
characters.text: You never pay Jail bail (leaving early is free). You can't be targeted by Audit.

characters.name: The Politician
characters.text: Your City Council vote is worth 200 influence instead of 100.

characters.name: The City Planner
characters.text: At game start, secretly look at 1 hidden Government tile of your choice. Each time you pass GO, secretly look at 1 more that is still hidden.

characters.name: The Medic
characters.text: If you're sent to the Hospital, you pay no bill and roll normally on your next turn. Insured markers cost you $25 instead of $50.
